diagnostics.message: `google_org_policy_policy.default` explicitly depends_on `google_tags_tag_key.default`, but it already depends_on `google_tags_tag_value.default`, which itself depends on `google_tags_tag_key.default` (tag value's parent is the tag key's id). The separate tag-key entry only duplicates an ordering that is already enforced transitively, so it can be removed without changing apply ordering.
